# `too-many-tools`

**Page rule** · `warning` · on by default

Large tool lists overflow small on-device model contexts and degrade tool selection.

A page rule judges the tool surface as a whole, so it needs a full snapshot: the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler, or `lint()` over a snapshot you collected yourself. Static analysis of a single `registerTool()` call cannot run it.

## Options

| Option | Default |
| ------ | ------- |
| `max`  | `20`    |

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "too-many-tools": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "too-many-tools": "warning" } }); // change severity
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "too-many-tools": { max: 20 } } });
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule too-many-tools=off
```
